title_en: Villa for sale in Lake Dry
description_en: Individual villas for sale at Lake Thate, Sauk area. The villa consists of 3 floors with a total area of ​​550m2 of land. Floor 0 - 95m2 of internal area, 20m2 of veranda. 1st floor - 95m2 internal area, 15m2 balcony. 2nd floor - 95m2 interior, 15m2 balcony. Terrace 95m2 The villa also has a swimming pool. It is surrounded by concrete walls to maintain privacy. There are 3 parking spaces in the project. View of the lake and Sauk Hills. The area offers greenery, clean air and tranquility that is missing in the capital. Has regular mortgage documentation.
